This required input qualifies original 266280 tracking allocation and its real
267870 pressure sweep, 1EC970 private actor iterator, 2677D0 actor tracking
retirement and 266150 extension reset. It also independently qualifies every
266490 retirement branch, including the low-state branches outside the older
1EC7B0 combat-reset predecessor profile. The new public retirement function is
only a wrapper around that unchanged existing native owner.

The canonical gzip JSON is `native_campaign_ai_tracking_allocate_tu15.json.gz`,
1,379,682 bytes; SHA256
`b15fdb2ab23a8d41279202fad32bec797fc8517fd562fd1732bf63b1db2483d9`.
It contains 172 complete unchanged physical original calls and 1,193 memory
failure prefixes. All 452 sites of the five new owners and all 45 sites of
266490 execute. The composition checks 96,747 ordered reads, 85,857 stores and
complete physical retained banks. Its 651 executed source sites include the
real allocator/deleter and position dependencies; the thirteen unreached
dependency-only sites retain their separate generic proofs.

The cases exercise the first empty cache slot, invalid index/salt eviction,
strict signed priority and timestamp tie selection, real query replacement,
allocation failure, actual pressure reclamation and retry, poison deletion,
first cached-reference clearing, three complete actor sweeps, signed count
thresholds, bitmap holes, iterator filtering/exhaustion and default-vector
aliases. No free slot, pressure result, query return or gameplay outcome is
supplied. The original private iterator is initialized as declared caller input
and its output fields are compared with a typed native local; it is not a
runtime guest stack or CPU adapter.

Tick conversion uses source SSE conversion/multiply and one balanced hardware
x87 integer conversion. Tests compare source controls and sticky status for
completed calls and every declared source-memory rejection prefix, covering
all rounding modes, three x87 precisions, NaNs, infinities, denormals and up to
seven live source x87 values. The native code preserves real ambient host FP
controls and live values. Unmasked FP traps and an exhausted original x87
stack require their original fault owner and reject explicitly. Ordinary
caller-private iterator storage must be disjoint from retained engine pools.

The observer authenticates TEST bitmap reads omitted by Capstone at 16E6C5
and 1EC9B4. Only F3AA/F3AB repeated stores consult ECX; scalar SSE operands
remain ordinary reads. No original instruction is patched, no original
dependency return is supplied and no stopped prefix is resumed. Exact complete
physical bank payloads are interned by SHA256, not rebuilt from store logs.

`analysis/campaign-native-kernels-20261028/ai-tracking-allocation/component-proof.json`
pins the independent exact physical repeat, GCC/Clang, all six actual native

The existing combat-reset suite also passes GCC, Clang, its two mutations and
